# Section 7 — Caveman Version

## 7.1 Both Side Cover Each Other
If outsider attack you because *my* mistake, I pay. Mistakes count:
- I break promise I made in deal
- I act very reckless or do bad thing on purpose
- My work steps on someone else's idea-rights

But NOT my problem if:
- You change my work yourself
- You bolt my work onto other stuff I no give you, and *that* cause problem
- You use my work in way deal no allow

Same rule both way. You mess up, you pay.

## 7.2 How Cover Work
You get attacked, you must:
1. Tell me fast, in writing. (Slow telling no kill my duty — unless slow really hurt my defense.)
2. Hand me wheel. I run fight, I run settle. But I no sign deal that say YOU guilty, or force YOU do something, unless you say ok. You no refuse ok for dumb reason.
3. Help me when I ask. I pay for your help time.

## 7.3 Damage Cap
**Big rule:** Neither side pay for ripple-damage — lost money, lost future deals, lost good name, lost data. Even if warned it might happen.

**Money ceiling:** Total pay never more than bigger of:
- fees Customer paid Provider in 12 months before trouble start, OR
- $100,000

**Cap NOT apply** (no ceiling, full pain) when:
- cover-duty from 7.1
- secret-spilling under Section 9
- very reckless or on-purpose bad act
- one side steal other side idea-rights

---

# Word Meanings

| Big word | Caveman meaning |
|---|---|
| **Indemnify** | I pay your bill when my mess hurt you |
| **Defend** | I hire lawyer, I fight case for you |
| **Hold harmless** | You walk away clean, no cost |
| **Third-party claim** | Outsider — not you, not me — come swinging |
| **Representation / warranty** | Promise fact true |
| **Covenant** | Promise do thing (or not do thing) |
| **Gross negligence** | Way past sloppy. Reckless |
| **Willful misconduct** | Knew bad, did anyway |
| **Infringe** | Step on someone patent/copyright/trademark |
| **Misappropriate** | Take secret not yours |
| **Materially prejudiced** | Real harm, not paper-cut harm |
| **Tender control of defense** | Give me driver seat in lawsuit |
| **Indirect / consequential damages** | Ripple harm, not first hit |
| **Punitive / exemplary damages** | Extra pain money, punish-money |
| **Loss of goodwill** | Name get muddy, people trust less |
| **Total cumulative liability** | All pay added up, whole deal life |
| **Carve-out** (the "EXCEPT FOR") | Hole in shield. Cap no protect here |

---

**Two things watch close:**
1. Carve-outs in 7.3 big. Cover-duty and secret-spilling have NO ceiling. Real money risk live there, not in $100k cap.
2. Cap say "greater of" — good for Customer. Small deal still get $100k floor.
